name: CKEditor5 horizontal line
description: Adds a horizontal-line (horizontal rule) button to CKEditor 5.
project_description:
This module adds Horizontal Line feature to CKEditor 5.

 The CKEditor5 horizontal line feature lets you visually divide your content into sections by inserting horizontal lines (also known as horizontal rules). It is an easy way to organize the content or indicate a change of topic.

 Support 

Please post bug reports, feature requests and support requests to the CKEditor 5 horizontal line module issue queue . If you met any problems with this module - feel free to create an issue.

 Demo 

 
 Go to https://simplytest.me/project/ckeditor5_horizontal_line . 
 Click "Launch Sandbox". 
 Install Drupal as normal. 
 Enable "CKEditor 5 horizontal line" module, and any optional modules you wish to try out. 
 Go to admin/config/content/formats/manage/full_html or any other editor where you wish to implement the functionality and drag the horizontal line icon on the active toolbar 
 Add/edit the content with editor, click on the horizontal line icon where the horizontal line feature lets you visually divide your content into sections by inserting horizontal lines (also known as horizontal rules). It is an easy way to organize the content or indicate a change of topic.
